name: X (formerly Twitter) oEmbed - publish.twitter.com / publish.x.com
tier_rationale: X Corp.: an established company with published developer terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted). Council P119 cond 6: registry x (X Corp, oEmbed) tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for whether X still serves a post through its published oEmbed interface and for the author handle it embeds; a 404 cannot tell deleted, protected and suspended apart, and post text is self-published content.

error_markers.reason: X oEmbed: error object inside an HTTP 200 answer (could not verify)

oembed.title: X oEmbed publish.twitter.com/oembed?url=<status URL> (301 -> publish.x.com): author handle and embed text of a post, or 404 when the post is no longer available

terms.quote: Terms 'unknown' until legal records the X oEmbed terms and confirms the P059 Internet Archive decision for this use: disabled in every profile until then (A1); default_enabled False.

oembed.notes: Quote: binding council text (P119 cond 6); research C0280 (verified_live 200; 2026-11-26 prep: publish.twitter.com answers 301 to publish.x.com, 200 application/json for a public post, 404 text/html 'Nothing to see here' for an unavailable one). Documented parameters only: url, omit_script=true, dnt=true. A 404 means 'no longer available (deleted, protected or suspended)', never 'deleted' or 'never existed'; 429/5xx = could not verify (P119 cond 3). twitter.com and x.com pages are never requested (not declared hosts). The cdn.syndication.twimg.com tweet-result endpoint (research C0260) is NOT a source of V3LUM: X's terms allow published interfaces only (P119 cond 2) - it may be revisited only with X's written consent recorded by legal. No rate-limit headers were seen; the 300/day budget and 1 req/s are V3LUM's own politeness limits (bulk oEmbed checks are rate-limited, research C0246). publish.x.com sets tracking cookies: the core never stores or replays them.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-3 (modules x_twitter_public and x_twitter_recovery, P119). Cache 24 h for 200 and 404 answers (the provider's 100-year max-age is capped). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review is still to be recorded; until then the policy gate sends them only on explicit selection (POL-07).
